defs.def: lack of success in doing or achieving sth 失败

ex.t: •学生报名并注明他们能分享的语言和他们有兴趣学习的语言。

ex.t: 他必须等待合适的____时机才能再次上去。

ex.s: As a result, the first four years of my postgraduate career were defined by a series of failures.
ex.t: 结果，我研究生生涯的前四年以一系列失败为特征。

ex.s: What was the solution by the adviser and the author after those repeated failures?
ex.t: 导师和作者在经历这些反复失败后采取的解决方案是什么？

ex.s: Most people with good sense would accept that we can and should learn from accidental failures.
ex.t: 共同面对困难可以治愈。

ex.t: 如果未能提供足够的陪同人员，每位缺少的成人将额外收费50美元。

ex.s: It is failure that brings improvement.
ex.t: 金门大桥50岁生日那天发生了什么？

ex.s: Failure can lead to progress.

ex.s: Failure should be avoided.

ex.s: We are often ashamed of our shortcomings, our mistakes and our failures.
ex.t: 38   你会一次又一次地犯错。

ex.s: Failure is the mother of success.
ex.t: 人们为什么来SAC？

ex.s: A quick review of successes and failures at the end of year will help _________your year ahead.

ex.s: Paris had suffered a sudden heart failure.
ex.t: 尽管如此，她还是犹豫了。

ex.s: Experts say Paris is right: For a sudden heart failure, the single best chance for survival is having someone nearby step in and do CPR quickly.
ex.t: 她被球击倒了。

defs.def: a person or thing that is not successful 失败的人（或事物）

ex.s: Though he acknowledges that engineering works can fail because the person who thought them up or engineered them simply got things wrong, in this book Dr Petroski widens his view to consider the larger context in which such failures occur.
ex.t: 有时设备失败是因为一个好的设计使用了低质量材料且施工不当。

defs.def: an act of not doing sth, especially sth that you are expected to do 未做，未履行（应做之事）

ex.s: What is your understanding of the line "Success is failure turned inside out"?
ex.t: 你对“成功是翻转过来的失败”这句话是怎么理解的？

ex.s: Life is queer with its twists and turns, As every one of us sometimes learns, And many a failure turns about, When he might have won had he stuck it out; Don't give up though the pace seems slow - You may succeed with another blow.
ex.t: 生活充满了曲折，我们每个人有时都会体会到，多少次的失败本可转为成功，只要他们当初坚持下去；即使步伐似乎缓慢，也千万不要放弃——你或许下一次努力就会成功。

ex.s: I had been disheartened by the failure of my Drawing Number One and my Drawing Number Two.
ex.t: 我的第一号画作和第二号画作的失败让我感到灰心丧气。

ex.s: Instantaneously, excitement and optimism turned into terror and failure.
ex.t: 顷刻之间，兴奋和乐观变成了恐惧和失败。

ex.s: Jordan says that the secret to his success is learning from his failures.
ex.t: 乔丹说他成功的秘诀就是从失败中学习。

defs.def: the state of not working correctly or as expected; an occasion when this happens 故障；失灵
a situation in which a business has to close because it is not successful 倒闭
a situation in which crops do not grow correctly and do not produce food 歉收
